name: default-label-read-not-primary
note: the rule omits the label; the reply picks BigLLM, so the only scored label is BigLLM (score 1). The omitted label resolves to default_label 'TinyLLM', which is absent from the score map and reads 0 -- not the lone entry primary() would read -- so the rule misses and routing falls open to default_model. A label-omitting rule still carries the reply's rationale in the trace
